channel.title: ByteBuy Blog: Laser Safety: Fire, Fumes and Eye Protection
channel.description: How to run a diode laser engraver safely at home: fire, fumes and eyes, plus four catalog products that help: a Mecpow fireproof enclosure, two fume-extractor bundles and the Class 1 enclosed SCULPFUN E1.
